# Kapot

> Kapot is a Belgian inline skating community organising events, contests and lessons. Based in Leuven, we welcome rollerbladers of all ages and skill levels.

Kapot teaches aggressive inline skating, hosts Belgium's annual Kapot Contest, and supports inline events across the country. By and for the inline skating community.

## Lessons

- **Sunday Group Class**: 10 lessons for €80. Group sessions at Sportoase skatepark in Leuven, 10:30 til' 12. Learn the basics of aggressive inline skating. Minimum 9 years old, protection gear and helmet required. Annual membership fee €40 (sports insurance included). Sign up: https://tally.so/r/wAY26B
- **Private session**: €40 per hour. Privately taught by one of our teachers. One pair of adaptable junior aggressive skates available — ask in advance. All ages and levels welcome. Book: https://calendly.com/kapot/private-session

## Events

- **Kapot Contest**, 1st of August 2026 at Sportoase skatepark, Leuven (Philipssite 6, 3001 Leuven). Belgium's annual celebration of inline skating, with skaters from around the world. Free entry. Event page: https://www.facebook.com/events/1298588894932094/
- **Nocturnus**, mid August at Blaarmeersen skatepark, Gent. Annual all-night inline skate jam, lights on until morning. Free.
